```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered = bind_rows(
  
  # 1. TOP TIER: High positive correlation, high frequency (n > 3), high identity (>90%)
  alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    filter(p_value <= 0.05, n > 3, cor_value >= 0, identity_human2mouse > 90) %>% 
    group_by(status) %>%
    arrange(-cor_value, -n) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
    mutate(filter = "High correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),
  
  # 2. SEQUENCE EXTREMES: Max identity per specific group (Immune, Non-Immune, All)
  alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    filter(status %in% c("Immune BTMs", "Non-Immune BTMs", "All")) %>%
    group_by(status) %>% 
    slice_max(identity_human2mouse, n = 5, with_ties = F) %>% 
    mutate(filter = "High %Identity"),
  
  # 3. TRANSCRIPTIONAL RESILIENCE: High correlation but Low identity
  alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    filter(n > 3, p_value <= 0.05) %>% 
    arrange(-cor_value, identity_human2mouse) %>% 
    group_by(status) %>% 
    slice_min(identity_human2mouse, n = 5)  %>% 
    mutate(filter = "High correlation,\nLow %Identity"),
  
  # 4. SEQUENCE DIVERGENCE: Min identity per specific group
  alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    filter(status %in% c("Immune BTMs", "Non-Immune BTMs", "All")) %>%
    group_by(status) %>% 
    slice_min(identity_human2mouse, n = 5, with_ties = F) %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Low %Identity"),

  # 5. QUADRANT CHECK: Low correlation but High identity (>90%)
  alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    filter(p_value <= 0.05, cor_value >= 0, identity_human2mouse > 90) %>% 
    group_by(status) %>%
    arrange(cor_value, -n) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Low correlation,\nHigh %Identity"),

  # 6. QUADRANT CHECK: Low correlation and Low identity (<90%)
  alignments_human2mouse_all_global_df_nshared %>%
    filter(p_value <= 0.05, cor_value >= 0, identity_human2mouse < 90) %>% 
    group_by(status) %>%
    arrange(-cor_value, -n) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(filter = "Low correlation,\nLow %Identity")
) %>% 
  # Final label cleaning and factor releveling
  mutate(
    status = str_replace(status, " ", "\n"),
    status = fct_relevel(status, "Human\nonly", "Mouse\nonly", "Shared", 
                         "All", "Non-Immune\nBTMs", "Immune\nBTMs")

  # 6. Statistical annotation: Median identity labels
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "label", aes(label = after_stat(round(y, 1))),
               size = 3, hjust = -0.2, color = "black", fill = "white") +
  
  # 7. Gene Labeling: Repel prevents overlapping names
  geom_label_repel(data = alignments_human2mouse_genes_filtered,
                   aes(label = gene, color = filter), 
                   max.overlaps = 10000, size = 2, direction = "y", nudge_x = -0.4,
                   hjust = 0, fill = "white", box.padding = unit(0, "cm"), label.padding = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
  
  # 8. Scales, Theme, and Layout
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), limits = c(50, 105)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0), legend.box.margin = margin(0,0,-10,0),
        plot.margin = margin(0.3, 0.3, 0, 0, unit = "cm")) +
  labs(x = "Status", y = "%Identity (Human-to-Mouse)", color = "", fill = "")

#Display
alignments_human2mouse_histogram_all_global

#Unite summary and distribution plots
alignments_human2mouse_pointrange_histogram = (alignments_human2mouse_pointrange_all_global /
alignments_human2mouse_histogram_all_global) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.25, 0.75),
              guides = "collect",
              # axes = "collect",
              axis_titles = "collect"
              ) +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "right",
                                legend.justification = "top"))
```

####### Align most conserved genes
Get global identity
```{r}
#Import
gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results_core_joined.rds"))
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

shared_genes_df = alignments_human2mouse_annotated_filtered %>% 
  select(filter, status, everything()) %>% 
  group_by(filter, status) %>% 
  slice_head(n  = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

shared_genes = shared_genes_df %>% 
  pull(gene) %>% 
  unique()


# 1. Setup biomaRt
# human_mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
# mouse_mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

# 2. Retrieve Pfam domains, GO terms, and Identity
# We include homology identity to correlate directly
domains_human <- getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "hgnc_symbol",
    "interpro",
    "interpro_start",
    "interpro_end",
    "interpro_short_description",
    # "tmhmm_start",
    # "tmhmm_end",
    "phobius",
    "phobius_start",
    "phobius_end"
  ),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  values = shared_genes,
  # values = "ABCE1",
  mart = human_mart
)

sequences_human = getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "hgnc_symbol",
    "peptide",
    "uniprotswissprot"
  ),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  values = shared_genes,
  # values = "ABCE1",
  mart = human_mart
) %>% 
  #Filter out non-canonical/annotated sequences
  filter(uniprotswissprot != "")

identity_human <- getBM(
  attributes = c("external_gene_name", 
                 "mmusculus_homolog_perc_id_r1",
                 "mmusculus_homolog_goc_score",
                 "mmusculus_homolog_orthology_confidence"),
  filters = "hgnc_symbol",
  # values = "ABCE1",
  values = shared_genes,
  mart = human_mart
) %>% 
  rename(hgnc_symbol = external_gene_name,
         identity = mmusculus_homolog_perc_id_r1)

# Join the tables
domains_identity_sequence_human = 
  sequences_human %>% 
  inner_join(domains_human, 
             by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  left_join(identity_human, 
            domains_human,
            by = "hgnc_symbol") %>% 
  group_by(hgnc_symbol, interpro) %>% 
  mutate(interpro_length = interpro_end - interpro_start) %>% 
  slice_max(interpro_length, n = 1)


#Mouse
genes_mouse = getBM(
  attributes = c("external_gene_name", 
                 "hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name"),
  filters = "external_gene_name",
  values = str_to_title(shared_genes),
  mart = mouse_mart
) %>% 
  rename(mgi_symbol = external_gene_name,
         hgnc_symbol = hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name)

domains_mouse <- getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "external_gene_name",
    "interpro",
    "interpro_start",
    "interpro_end",
    "interpro_short_description",
    # "tmhmm_start",
    # "tmhmm_end",
    "phobius",
    "phobius_start",
    "phobius_end"
    # "signalp_start",
    # "signalp_end"
  ), 
  filters = "external_gene_name",
  values = genes_mouse$mgi_symbol,
  mart = mouse_mart
)

sequences_mouse = getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "external_gene_name",
    "peptide",
    "uniprotswissprot"
  ),
  filters = "external_gene_name",
  values = genes_mouse$mgi_symbol,
  # values = "Abce1",
  mart = mouse_mart
) %>% 
  #Filter out non-canonical/annotated sequences
  filter(uniprotswissprot != "")

#Merge
domains_identity_sequence_mouse = 
  sequences_mouse %>% 
  inner_join(domains_mouse, 
             by = "external_gene_name") %>% 
  rename(mgi_symbol = external_gene_name) %>% 
  left_join(genes_mouse, 
            by = "mgi_symbol") %>% 
  arrange(interpro_start) %>% 
  group_by(mgi_symbol, interpro) %>% 
  mutate(interpro_length = interpro_end - interpro_start) %>% 
  slice_max(interpro_length, n = 1)


#Merge Human and Mouse
genes_domain_mouse_human <- domains_identity_sequence_mouse %>% 
  inner_join(domains_identity_sequence_human, 
             by = join_by(hgnc_symbol, interpro), 
             suffix = c("_mouse", "_human")) %>% 
  drop_na(peptide_mouse, peptide_human) %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df %>% 
               select(filter, status, hgnc_symbol = gene, n, cor_value, p_value, r_squared, cor_label) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "hgnc_symbol")

glimpse(genes_domain_mouse_human)

genes_domain_mouse_human %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_gsea_leganalysis_biomart_annotation.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Pairwise sequence alignment
library(pwalign)
#Compare two original sequences
alignment <- pairwiseAlignment(
  pattern = gene_data$peptide_human, 
  subject = gene_data$peptide_mouse, 
  substitutionMatrix = "BLOSUM62",
  type = "global", # Garante alinhamento de ponta a ponta
  gapOpening = 10,  # Penalidade padrão
  gapExtension = 0.5
)

# Get identity score
identity_global <- pid(alignment, type = "PID1")

#Convert to a df
alignment_results_pairwise <- tibble(
  hgnc_symbol       = gene_data$hgnc_symbol,
  seq_human_orig    = gene_data$peptide_human,
  seq_mouse_orig    = gene_data$peptide_mouse,
  seq_human_aligned = as.character(pattern(alignment)),
  seq_mouse_aligned = as.character(subject(alignment)),
  identity          = identity_global
) %>% 
  inner_join(genes_domain_mouse_human %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(mgi_symbol, hgnc_symbol, identity_biomart = identity, peptide_mouse, peptide_human, uniprotswissprot_human,
         filter, status, n, cor_value, p_value, r_squared, cor_label) %>% 
  distinct(),
  by = "hgnc_symbol")



```


```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
library(tidyverse)

#Prepare data with biomart annotations  ===========
gene_info <- alignment_results_pairwise %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol == selected_gene) %>%
  mutate(
    len_mouse = nchar(seq_mouse_orig),
    len_human = nchar(seq_human_orig)
  ) %>% 
  slice_max(len_human, n = 1) %>% 
  slice_max(len_mouse, n = 1)

# Create "Full Protein" 
full_protein <- gene_info %>%
  select(hgnc_symbol, len_mouse, len_human, status, cor_label,
         seq_human_orig, seq_mouse_orig, filter, identity, identity_biomart, seq_human_aligned, seq_mouse_aligned) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("len_"), names_to = "species", values_to = "end") %>%
    group_by(hgnc_symbol, species) %>% 
  slice_max(end, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    species = str_remove(species, "len_"),
    start = 1,
    interpro_short_description_human = "Full Protein",
    interpro = "Full",
    species_end = species
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

# Get uniprot data  ===========
prot_data <- drawProteins::get_features("P06729 P08920") %>% 
             drawProteins::feature_to_dataframe() %>% 
  mutate(description = case_when(type == "TRANSMEM" ~ "TM",
                                 type == "TOPO_DOM" & description == "Extracellular" ~ "EC",
                                 type == "TOPO_DOM" & description == "Cytoplasmic" ~ "CP",
                                 description == "NONE" ~ type,
                                 description == "" ~ type,
                                 T ~ description)) %>% 
  separate(entryName, sep = "_", into = c("gene", "organism"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(organism = str_to_title(organism))

#Identify mutations ===========
# Extract positions from alignment
vec_h <- strsplit(unique(full_protein$seq_human_aligned), "")[[1]]
vec_m <- strsplit(unique(full_protein$seq_mouse_aligned), "")[[1]]

# Find divergences
diff_idx <- which(vec_h != vec_m)

# Map position and skip gaps
mutations_base <- tibble(
  align_pos = diff_idx,
  res_h = vec_h[diff_idx],
  res_m = vec_m[diff_idx]
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Get position intervals
    pos_real_human = map_int(align_pos, ~sum(vec_h[1:.x] != "-")),
    pos_real_mouse = map_int(align_pos, ~sum(vec_m[1:.x] != "-"))
  )

# Separate by species
mutations_human <- mutations_base %>%
  filter(res_h != "-") %>% 
  mutate(species = "human", x_pos = pos_real_human)

mutations_mouse <- mutations_base %>%
  filter(res_m != "-") %>%
  mutate(species = "mouse", x_pos = pos_real_mouse)

# Prepare table for ggplot
mutations_plot <- bind_rows(mutations_human, mutations_mouse) %>% 
  rename(organism = species) %>% 
  mutate(gene = gene_info$hgnc_symbol %>% unique(),
         organism = str_to_title(organism),
         type = "Alignment",
         description = "Mutations")
```

####### Structure
draw proteins
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width= 10, paged.print=TRUE}
# Labeling y axis
prot_name <- unique(prot_data$entryName)

df_topology <- prot_data %>% 
  filter(type %in% c("TOPO_DOM", "TRANSMEM", "SIGNAL")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = 1)

df_features <- prot_data %>% 
  filter(type %in% c("DOMAIN", "REGION", "MOTIF", "RECEPT_DOM")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = 1.5)

df_modifications <- prot_data %>% 
  filter(type %in% c("MOD_RES", "PHOSPHO", "VARIANT")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = 1.61) 

df_mutations = mutations_plot


# Create a summary dataframe to define the background line length for each facet
background_lines <- prot_data %>%
  group_by(organism, gene) %>%
  summarise(max_end = max(end), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Duplicate rows to draw lines at both y=1 and y=2
  tidyr::crossing(y_val = c(1, 1.5))


# --- UNIPROT PROTEIN ANNOTATION PLOT ---
drawprotein_uniprot_ggplot = ggplot() +
  # --- MAIN CHAIN BACKGROUND (Dynamic length per facet) ---
  geom_segment(data = background_lines,
               aes(x = 1, xend = max_end, y = y_val, yend = y_val), 
               color = "grey80", size = 2) +
  
  # --- TRACK 1: TOPOLOGY (TOPO_DOM and TRANSMEM) ---
  # Drawing rectangles for extracellular, cytoplasmic, and transmembrane regions
  geom_rect(data = df_topology,
            aes(xmin = begin, xmax = end, 
                ymin = y_pos - 0.1, ymax = y_pos + 0.1, 
                fill = description,
                labels = description),
            color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  
  # Faceting by organism and gene for multi-protein comparison
  facet_wrap(~paste(organism, sep = " ", gene), ncol = 1) +
  
  # Manual color scale for the first 'fill' aesthetic (Topology)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EC" = "#4cc9f0", 
                               "CP" = "#3a86ff", 
                               "TM" = "#90A4AEFF",
                               "SIGNAL" = "#f72585"), 
                    name = "Topology") +
  
  # --- SCALE RESET ---
  # Critical: Specify 'fill' to allow a second independent fill scale
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() + 
  
  # --- TRACK 2: DOMAINS AND FUNCTIONS ---
  # Drawing rectangles for functional domains and regions
  geom_rect(data = df_features,
            aes(xmin = begin, xmax = end, 
                ymin = y_pos - 0.1, ymax = y_pos + 0.1, 
                fill = description,
                labels = description),
            color = "black", 
            size = 0.2,
            alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Second fill
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", name = "Domains") +
  
  # --- POINTS: MODIFICATIONS (Phosphorylation / Variants) ---
  # Adding Diamond shapes slightly offset from the domain line
  geom_point(data = df_modifications,
             aes(x = begin, y = y_pos + 0.02, color = type,
                 labels = description), 
             size = 3, shape = 18) +
  
  # Color scale for points (PTMs and Mutations)
  scale_color_manual(values = c("PHOSPHO" = "yellow", "VARIANT" = "red"), 
                     name = "PTMs") +
  
  new_scale_color() +
  
  # MUTATIONS (Violin + Points) ---
  geom_violin(data = mutations_plot,
              aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.5, color = "Mutations"),
              fill = NA, size = 0.4, width = 0.2, scale = "count", adjust = .05) +
  geom_point(data = mutations_plot,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = 1.5, color = "Mutations",
                 label = paste(align_pos, res_h, res_m)),
             shape = 124, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mutations" = "red"), name = "Alignment") +
  
  # --- AXIS AND THEME FORMATTING ---
  # Mapping the custom y_pos values to descriptive labels
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(unique(df_topology$y_pos), unique(df_features$y_pos)), 
                     labels = c("Topology", "Domains")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +

  
  #Label the start and end of domains
  geom_text(aes(label = begin,
                      y = y_pos,
                      x = begin),
                  data = df_features,
                  nudge_y = 0.15,
                  segment.linetype = 0,
                  hjust = 0.5,
                  size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = end,
                      y = y_pos,
                      x = end),
                  data = df_features,
                  nudge_y = -0.15,
                  segment.linetype = 0,
                  hjust = 0.5,
                  size = 3) +
  #Label the start and end of topologies
  geom_text(aes(label = begin,
                      y = y_pos,
                      x = begin),
                  data = df_topology,
                  nudge_y = 0.15,
                  hjust = 0.5,
                  size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = end,
                      y = y_pos,
                      x = end),
                  data = df_topology,
                  nudge_y = -0.15,
                  hjust = 0.5,
                  size = 3) 
  
  # Custom lab theme and final adjustments
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.justification = "top",
```

```{r}
library(NGLVieweR)
library(dplyr)

# --- 1. DEFINIÇÃO MANUAL DE CORES PARA DOMÍNIOS ---
# Escolhi cores distintas para garantir que cada domínio apareça
domain_colors <- colors_all

# --- 2. PREPARAÇÃO DA TABELA ---
df_features_3d <- df_features %>%
  mutate(
    # Atribui uma cor da lista para cada linha da tabela
    color_3d = domain_colors[1:n()], 
    selection = paste0(begin, "-", end)
  )

# --- 3. INICIALIZAÇÃO DO VISUALIZADOR ---
view_domain <- NGLVieweR(here::here("Structures", "CD2_HumanAF-P06729-F1-model_v6.pdb")) %>%
  stageParameters(
    backgroundColor = "white",
    cameraType = "orthographic",
    clipDist = 0,
    sampleLevel = 4,   # Melhora a qualidade (Antialias)
    preserveDrawingBuffer = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # Proteína base em cinza claro e bem transparente
  addRepresentation("cartoon", param = list(color = "#D3D3D3", opacity = 0.2))

# --- 4. LOOP DE DOMÍNIOS (CORES FIXAS) ---
for(i in seq_len(nrow(df_features_3d))){
  
  current_color <- as.character(df_features_3d$color_3d[i])
  current_sele  <- as.character(df_features_3d$selection[i])
  
  if(!is.na(current_color)){
    view_domain <- view_domain %>%
      addRepresentation("cartoon", param = list(
        sele = current_sele,
        color = current_color,
        opacity = 1
      ))
  }
}

for(i in seq_len(nrow(df_features_3d))){
  
  # 1. Pegar a descrição e extrair a primeira letra (em maiúscula)
  desc_char <- toupper(substr(as.character(df_features_3d$description[i]), 1, 1))
  
  # 2. Obter a seleção (formato "1-50")
  res_range <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(as.character(df_features_3d$selection[i]), "-")))
  
  # 3. Selecionar e atribuir a letra da descrição à Chain
  sele <- atom.select(pdb, resno = res_range[1]:res_range[2])
  
  if(length(sele$atom) > 0){
    pdb$atom$chain[sele$atom] <- desc_char
  }
}

# Salvar na sua área de trabalho para fácil acesso no Zorin OS
write.pdb(pdb, file = here("Structures", "cd2_com_chains.pdb"))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----
#Safe correlation 
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}
# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label, ", ", n
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),
      p_label_mouse,", ", n
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_mean_Human <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse_human = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse_human   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse_human = cor_value_mouse_human^2,
    p_label_mouse_human = case_when(
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse_human = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse_human, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse_human, 2),
      p_label_mouse_human,", ", n
    )
  )


dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "2", "Early hours")~"Early hours", 
                               pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
         facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))


dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint, timepoint_comparison)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse_human = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse_human, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse_human, 2),
      p_label_mouse_human, ", ", n
    )
  )



dge_btm_nes_group_correlation_df = dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "2", "Early hours")~"Early hours", 
                               pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
         facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))
```

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
    select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
    distinct() %>%

      names_from = organism,

    ) %>%

safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%

  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

filter_1 = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            median_cor = median(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
gsea_hallmarks_results_core = gsea_hallmarks_results_all_matched %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/") 

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined =
  gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status)

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----
#Safe correlation 
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}
# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),

    )

  mutate(

    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),
      p_label_mouse
    )
  )

cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse_Human <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_Human <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = nes_Mouse,
         Human = nes_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse_human = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse_human   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse_human = cor_value_mouse_human^2,
    p_label_mouse_human = case_when(
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse_human = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse_human, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse_human, 2),
      p_label_mouse_human
    )
  )



dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df = dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate( timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
         facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Saureus", "Ecoli", "Burn", "Trauma"))


dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint, timepoint_comparison)
```

####### Plot means

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#Plot correlation plot (means)
dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_plot = 
  
  bind_rows(
    dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
      mutate(filter = "All"),
    
    dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
      filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_mean_Human >0.25) %>% 
      mutate(filter = "Mouse"),
    
    dge_hallmarks_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
      filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25 & p_adjust_mean_Human <= 0.25) %>% 
      mutate(filter = "Mouse and Human"),
  ) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
      y = mean_log2fc_Human) +
  facet_nested_wrap(vars(pathogen, facet_name),
                    scales = "free",
                    nrow = 4,
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
  
    #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2, slope = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  
#Plot all points
  with_blur(
    geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 color = group,
                 shape = filter),
                 data = . %>% filter(filter == c("All")),
             size = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.2,
    sigma = 2)
    ) +
  #Filtered
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 shape = filter,
                 color = group),
             data = . %>% filter(filter == c("Mouse")),
             size = 1.5,
             alpha = 1
             ) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group,
                 shape = filter),
             color = "black",
             data = . %>% filter(filter == c("Mouse and Human")),
             size = 1.5,
             stroke = 0.5,
             alpha = 1,
             ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hallmarks_colors) +
  guides(color = F,
         fill = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE,  nrow = 3,
                           keywidth = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                           keyheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                           override.aes = list(size = 3, shape = 21, color = "black"),
                           default.unit="cm"),
         shape = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE,  
                              nrow = 3,
                             keywidth = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                           keyheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                          override.aes = list(size = 3),
                           default.unit="cm")) +
  labs(fill = "Group",
       shape = "Significance",
       y = "Human (Mean Log2FC)",
       x = "Model (Mean Log2FC)") +
  #Theme
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0., vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal", 
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1),
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")
          )
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
dge_hallmarks_nes_group_correlation_df = dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
```
